class.name: IfcMetric
class.brief_description: An IfcMetric is used to capture quantitative resultant metrics that can be applied to objectives. HISTORY: New Entity in IFC Release 2.0 Use Definition IfcMetric is a subtype of IfcConstraint and may be associated with any subtype of IfcRoot through the IfcRelAssociatesConstraint relationship in the IfcControlExtension schema, or may be associated with IfcProperty by IfcPropertyConstraintRelations

members.member: Enumeration that identifies the type of benchmark data. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset.
Reference source for data values. A String, or null when unset.
The value with data type defined by the underlying type accesses via IfcMetricValueSelect . A value or a GDIFCEntityBase, or null when unset.
Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
